Hello Ramesh ji, namaste. Main Sunita bo.text: Sunita says she is calling about painting her flat.
Hello Ramesh ji, namaste. Main Sunita bo.quote: Hello Ramesh ji, namaste. Main Sunita bol rahi hoon, apne flat ki painting ke liye baat karni thi.

Ji namaste madam, boliye. Kaunsa flat ha.text: Ramesh asks which flat it is and how big it is.
Ji namaste madam, boliye. Kaunsa flat ha.quote: Ji namaste madam, boliye. Kaunsa flat hai, kitna bada hai?

2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedro.text: Sunita says the flat is a 2BHK in Sector 62, Noida with two bedrooms, a hall, a kitchen, and both bathroom ceilings to be painted.
2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedro.value: 2BHK flat in Sector 62, Noida; two bedrooms, hall, kitchen, and both bathroom ceilings
2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedro.quote: 2BHK hai, Sector 62 Noida mein. Do bedroom, hall, kitchen, aur dono bathroom ki ceiling karni hai.

Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai.text: Ramesh asks whether the job is only interior work or also includes the balcony and outside area.
Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai.quote: Theek hai madam. Sirf andar ka kaam hai ya balcony aur bahar ka bhi?

Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.text: Sunita says the job is only interior work, with two coats, putty where needed, and Asian Paints Royale.
Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.value: interior painting with two coats, putty where needed, Asian Paints Royale
Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.quote: Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jahan zaroorat ho wahan putty, aur paint Asian Paints ka Royale chahiye.

Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.text: Sunita says the paint should be Asian Paints Royale.
Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jaha.quote: Sirf andar ka. Do coat lagane hain, jahan zaroorat ho wahan putty, aur paint Asian Paints ka Royale chahiye.

Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do.text: Ramesh accepts that the job is to paint the full 2BHK from inside with two coats, putty where needed, and Royale paint.
Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do.value: full inside 2BHK painting with two coats, putty where needed, Royale paint
Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do.quote: Ho jayega madam. Poora 2BHK andar se, do coat, putty ke saath, Royale paint. Pakka.

Madam material aur labour mila ke 45 haz.text: Ramesh says the total for material and labour will be 45,000 rupees.
Madam material aur labour mila ke 45 haz.quote: Madam material aur labour mila ke 45 hazaar lagega.

45 toh bahut zyada hai bhaiya. 40 mein k.text: Sunita proposes 40,000 rupees for the job instead of 45,000 rupees.
45 toh bahut zyada hai bhaiya. 40 mein k.quote: 45 toh bahut zyada hai bhaiya. 40 mein kar do.

Madam Royale mehenga paint hai. Chalo 42.text: Ramesh says the final price is 42,000 rupees and he will not do less.
Madam Royale mehenga paint hai. Chalo 42.quote: Madam Royale mehenga paint hai. Chalo 42 hazaar final, isse kam nahi hoga.

Theek hai, 42 hazaar done. Material tumh.text: Sunita accepts the 42,000 rupees total that Ramesh proposed.
Sunita asks whether Ramesh will provide the material.

Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shu.text: Ramesh says all the material will be his.
Ramesh says he wants some advance before starting the work.
Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shu.quote: Bas kaam shuru karne se pehle thoda advance chahiye, paint khareedna padega.

Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shu.text: Ramesh says the paint needs to be bought.
Haan ji, material sab mera. Bas kaam shu.quote: Bas kaam shuru karne se pehle thoda advance chahiye, paint khareedna padega.

15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.text: Sunita offers 10,000 rupees as the advance, to be paid by UPI tomorrow.
15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.quote: 15 nahi, 10 hazaar deti hoon, kal UPI se.

Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance ka.text: Worker Ramesh accepts the advance as 10,000 rupees to be sent tomorrow by UPI.
Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance ka.quote: Chaliye theek hai, das hazaar advance kal bhej dijiye.

Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi..text: Ramesh asks when the work should start.
Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi..quote: Woh dekh lenge madam, koi tension nahi. Aap yeh batao kaam kab se shuru karna hai?

Somwar se shuru kar do, 23 November se..text: Sunita says the work should start on Monday, 23 November.
Somwar se shuru kar do, 23 November se..quote: Somwar se shuru kar do, 23 November se.

Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat di.text: Ramesh accepts starting on 23 November and finishing by 30 November.
Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat di.quote: Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat din ka kaam hai, 30 November tak khatam kar dunga.

Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat di.text: Ramesh says the work will take seven days and finish by 30 November.
Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat di.quote: Ji, 23 November somwar se shuru. Saat din ka kaam hai, 30 November tak khatam kar dunga.

Pakka 30 tak? Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe.text: Sunita asks whether Ramesh is certain the work will be finished by 30 November.
Sunita says guests are coming to her home on 2 December.
Pakka 30 tak? Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe.quote: Mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe hain 2 December ko.

Pakka madam, 30 November tak poora ho ja.text: Ramesh confirms the work will be completed by 30 November 2026.
Pakka madam, 30 November tak poora ho ja.quote: Pakka madam, 30 November tak poora ho jayega.

Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.text: Ramesh says the total becomes 43,000 rupees.
Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.quote: Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme se 10 advance kal.

Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.text: Ramesh says 10,000 rupees will be paid as advance tomorrow.
Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme s.quote: Toh madam total 43 hazaar hua na, usme se 10 advance kal.

Haan theek hai. Aur dekho, furniture dha.text: Sunita says the furniture must be covered during the work and cleaning is also the worker's responsibility.
Haan theek hai. Aur dekho, furniture dha.quote: Haan theek hai. Aur dekho, furniture dhak ke kaam karna, safai bhi tumhari.

Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai.text: The worker says they will cover everything and leave only after cleaning up.
Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai.value: cover everything and clean up before leaving
Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai.quote: Bilkul madam, sab cover kar denge, safai karke hi jayenge.

Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej d.text: Sunita says she will send the advance tomorrow.
Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej d.quote: Chalo theek hai phir, kal advance bhej deti hoon.

Ji madam, dhanyavaad. Somwar ko subah 9.text: The worker says he will come on Monday morning at 9 a.m.
Ji madam, dhanyavaad. Somwar ko subah 9.quote: Ji madam, dhanyavaad. Somwar ko subah 9 baje aa jaunga.

Theek hai, somwar ko milte hain. Namaste.text: Sunita accepts that they will meet on Monday.
Theek hai, somwar ko milte hain. Namaste.quote: Theek hai, somwar ko milte hain.
